name: Can foreign nationals get a mortgage in the U.S. to buy property?

mainEntity.name: Can foreign nationals get a mortgage in the U.S. to buy property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, foreign nationals can typically obtain a mortgage in the U.S., but the process differs from that for U.S. citizens. Lenders often require a larger down payment, usually 20-40%, and may have stricter eligibility criteria, such as a higher credit score or substantial financial reserves. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution can connect buyers with lenders experienced in foreign national loans to explore suitable options in Florida.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, foreign nationals can get a mortgage, but generally require larger down payments and meet specific lender criteria.
